verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents risk registers, risk assessments, assets, personnel, devices, and trust-center questionnaire automation. None of it describes a third-party vendor inventory or vendor risk reviews covering security posture, data access, or review cadence. Vendor risk management is a fair axis for a compliance platform, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na". The risk-register and questionnaire features are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an operations lead, third-party vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform — security posture, data access, review cadence — instead of a spreadsheet
